Compare each pair.

V09: Reference cropped view without header; candidate shows full header. Layout of detail matches: image, name, price, color swatches selected walnut, variant thumbnails row. Candidate has 4 thumbnails in left column vs reference 4 (ref shows 4 with last being diagram; candidate shows 5 including a beige variant thumb). Differences minor: extra thumbnail, header present. Score 1 or 0.75. Structure, image, swatches match. Left thumbnail column differs slightly (candidate adds 5th thumb). I'd say 0.75 or 1. The criteria: 切换后的图片、名称、变体缩略图与共用详情布局. Mostly matches; minor differences like thumbnail count. 0.75 maybe, but difference is small local. Reference scrolled down slightly (no header). Score 1? There's also chat icon position. I'll give 1... but the extra thumbnail in gallery is a small local diff. 0.75 = key layout correct, few local diffs. Choose 0.75? Hmm. Reference has 4 thumbs (product, 2 room scenes, diagram), candidate 5 (product, 2 room scenes, diagram, beige cabinet). That's local. 0.75.

V10: Nearly identical. Differences: "Arrives Oct 27" vs "Oct 26"; STUBBARP discount "19% off" vs "20% off"; minor layout widths. 1.

V11: Drawer matches: 6 parts list, quantities, overlay. Candidate includes thumbnails in the parts list (reference text-only? Reference shows no thumbnails in parts list; candidate shows images). Actually reference right drawer shows text only items; candidate shows product images in list. That's a difference but arguably enhanced. Criteria: 背景遮罩、右侧部件清单、数量和间距. Quantities and items match. Adding thumbnails—local difference. 0.75? The drawer width similar. I'd give 0.75 or 1. Ref items list rows without images; candidate with images changes row heights/spacing. 0.75.

Hmm, but rubric says 1 = major structure, proportion, images, hierarchy, style match. Candidate added images where reference has none — changes row layout notably. 0.75.

V12: Very close match. Minor: topic pills "Durability" fully visible vs truncated "Dur...y"; helpful icons differ slightly. Score 1.
